lines.l: How did you know about love?
Is it once in a lifetime?
I'm easy if you let it be
So why am I buying you shit that I can't afford
And turning up unannounced, it's yours
What have you done to me?
But I've been thinking a bit more casually
Not holding much hope for us
And maybe I'll stop like it
If I could read it and you'll write it
Is it worth the thinking critically
Don't want to know about us
